query_analysis.original_query: Our filtration process is struggling with cake resistance. How can we develop an advanced mathematical model to predict filtration rate considering varying cake resistance and medium properties?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop an advanced mathematical model to predict filtration rates in our filtration process by accounting for varying cake resistance and filtration medium properties to improve operational performance.

selected_agents.role: Provide process data and expertise on cake resistance

communication_strategy.information_flow: Mathematical model development guided by filtration process data

clarification_questions: Can you provide detailed properties of the filtration medium and cake material?
What are the specific operating conditions (pressure, temperature) of your process?
Do you have existing data on how cake resistance varies under different conditions?
Are there any specific computational constraints or preferred modeling approaches?
